acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves deterministic provenance and tamper rejection; a valid digest is neither human approval nor execution authorization.
evidenceRequired: Canonical digest fixtures cover every assumption-to-handoff transition.
Replay, tampering, stale-revision, skipped-stage, path-escape, and digest-mismatch tests pass.

completionCriteria: The working assumption, assembled brief, proposed backlog, adoption decision, governed handoff, and returned receipt each have a deterministic canonical digest.
Every downstream artifact binds its predecessor digest, repository revision, and governing source hashes.
Validation fails closed when the repository revision, source hash, assumption, brief, proposal, adoption decision, or handoff changes.
A saved proposal remains non-canonical and cannot be compiled into an execution-capable handoff without a separate valid adoption receipt.
Replay, tampering, stale-revision, skipped-stage, path-escape, and digest-mismatch tests pass.
nonObjectives: Do not make a proposed backlog canonical automatically.
Do not dispatch AgentFlow or imply that a valid digest is human approval.
Do not create a parallel artifact store or authority graph.
objective: Create an unbroken, tamper-evident provenance chain from repository-derived assumption through adopted AgentFlow handoff.
title: Bind the assumption-to-handoff provenance chain
